kids.name: title
kids.chars: §4.4 · the TICKS burst at 40 Hz on one FR-2 region (341 × 256 px): requests and starts per source  0–2 000 ms of 5 000

kids.name: key
kids.chars: Short grey marks: a request (every tick changes in the worst direction; the heatmap every 100 ms). Tall marks: a start the source admits by its own rule. Shaded: the half-open 1 000 ms windows. In the sum lane, starts at the same ms sit side by side, 6 px apart, in FR-9's order.

kids.name: line 1
kids.chars: 80 requests; alone (FR-1) max 2 starts in any window (§4.4 L222: 2)

kids.name: line 1
kids.chars: 20 requests; alone (FR-6) max 2 starts in any window (§4.4 L224: 2)

kids.name: line 1
kids.chars: max 5 starts in a window ≥ FR-7 (3): fails the gate; why FR-3 exists (§4.4)

kids.name: title
kids.chars: §4.3 · the region arbiter on the same burst: who is admitted, ranked by FR-9 (liquidation, then the focused symbol, then the rest); at most 2 starts a window

kids.name: key
kids.chars: Tall marks: an admitted start. Short grey marks: a request held by the source's own interval. Red marks low in the lane: a request the region refused — dropped, never queued; the source asks again on its next change and its value still updates (R-4).
